# Template:Xtaglink

<div class="mw-parser-output">

A template to simplify cross-referencing definition [tags](/templates/tag) between different pages. Use [Template:Taglink](/templates/taglink) for links to tags within the same page.

Usage:

    &#123;&#123;xtaglink|Gamedev:UnitDefs|builder&#125;&#125;

Result:

[builder](/gamedev-unitdefs#builder)

Usage (Optional 3rd param to link to a tag with a given value):

    &#123;&#123;xtaglink|Gamedev:UnitDefs|builder|true&#125;&#125;

Result: [builder](/gamedev-unitdefs#builder) = true

N.B. Please do not use this tag *within* a \<code\> block when documenting a formula tags are used in - it will break the markup and is confusing. See [Gamedev:WeaponDefs#Tag:burstRate](/gamedev-weapondefs#tagburstrate) for an example of the proper usage in this case.

</div>
